privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This platform follows the principle of jahàla: nothing is hidden. Here is exactly what data we process and why.
privacy.dataBody: Administrators: name, email address and password (encrypted). Mosque: name, city, geographic coordinates and prayer-time calculation method. No data is collected about visitors to the public page.
privacy.trackingBody: No advertising cookies, no third-party trackers, no selling of data. Only the cookies strictly necessary for authentication are used.
privacy.retentionBody: Your data belongs to you. You can export it at any time from the settings and request its deletion unconditionally.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: The database is hosted by Neon and emails are sent through Resend. These providers only access data to deliver their service.
privacy.contactBody: For any question about your data, contact the administrator of your mosque.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your mosque configuration
settings.prayerCardDesc: Enter the actual times displayed in your mosque. These are what appear on the public page.
settings.dataCardDesc: Download all your data at any time. Your data belongs to you — no forced retention.
settings.tzDesc: The displayed times are the ones you enter yourself (“Prayer times” card). The method below is only used as a basis for the “Suggest times” button and does not change what is displayed.
settings.tzHelp: For Guinea: Africa/Conakry. Elsewhere: Europe/Paris, Asia/Riyadh…
settings.contactDesc: Information shown in the public footer (all optional)
settings.donationHelp: Link to your donation page. It opens in a new tab. Donations are handled directly by the mosque — the platform processes no payment.

prayerTimes.title: Prayer times
prayerTimes.intro: The iqama is the time shown large (required attendance). The adhan is optional. Leave empty to hide it.
prayerTimes.suggestDone: Calculated adhans inserted. The iqama is still yours to set for your mosque.
prayerTimes.jumuaNote: Jumu'ah is shown only on Friday.
